text: In this world... the kinder you are, the taller you grow.
Leo was the shortest kid in town.
Max was the tallest. And he never let anyone forget it.
One morning, Leo saw an old lady struggling with her heavy bags.
So he carried them all the way to her house.
And he grew. Just a little.
At lunch, he shared his food with the new kid. He grew again.
Max pushed a kid out of the line... and shrank.
Every day, Leo was kind. And every day, Max was mean.
Until one day, Max tripped and fell. Everyone laughed. Everyone... except Leo.
Leo reached down and helped him up.
And when Max said thank you... he grew. For the very first time.
In this world, you don't look up to the tallest. You look up to the kindest.
